rule: OpenAI reports almost every uncached prompt token of a request of 1,024 tokens or more as a cache write, as the committed rows that report the count show, and prices it at the cache-write rate. A runner that didn't read the count under-priced those requests by (cache_write - input) x uncached tokens / 1e6. Above 272,000 input tokens OpenAI prices the whole request at the long-context rates, so every figure records the largest request the committed data shows or bounds. Prices are OpenAI's list prices (developers.openai.com/api/docs/pricing, read 2026-11-09).
